hints: How do you get just the last digit of a number, and how do you throw it away to reach the next one?
Repeatedly add n % 10 to a sum and divide n by 10. N can be up to 1018, so read it into a long (or simply treat the input as a string of digits).

approaches.name: Optimal
approaches.idea: Peel off digits with % 10 and / 10 and add them up (equivalently, add the characters of the input string).

explain: For 12345 the loop adds 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 for a total of 15. Each step removes one digit, so a 19-digit number takes 19 steps. N = 0 never enters the loop and correctly prints 0. 1018 does not fit in an int, so use long in Java (in JavaScript, summing the characters of the string avoids precision loss).
recognize: "Something about each digit of a number" → loop with % 10 and / 10.
python:
import sys
n = int(sys.stdin.read().split()[0])
total = 0
while n > 0:
    total += n % 10
    n //= 10
print(total)
